overview_description.description: Clawvisor provides a credential-vaulting gateway and authorization layer for AI agents that need access to external applications and APIs. The platform sits between agents, third-party APIs, and LLM providers to mediate every tool call against an approved task purpose. It keeps API keys and OAuth tokens in an encrypted vault, injects credentials server-side, and prevents agents from directly handling secrets. Clawvisor verifies each request using purpose-based authorization, blocking prompt-injection attempts, scope creep, and inconsistent actions before they reach provider APIs. The product offers human-in-the-loop approvals, risk scoring, and detailed per-task audit logs across connected services such as email, calendars, storage, messaging, version control, and payments. Clawvisor is available as a hosted cloud service and as self-hosted software that can run on private infrastructure for teams and organizations deploying agentic workflows.
